shortDescription: Tokenized stock trading volume on decentralized exchanges reached $20.9 billion over the past 30 days. According to Odaily, Uniswap V4 led the market with a 40.7% share, followed by Uniswap V3 at 19.4%, and the two versions together accounted for 60.1% of trading volume, or about $12.6 billion.
